comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and clear auto-hide reproduction. Power Display positions against the active display work area, so the missing detail is taskbar geometry: please tell us which edge the auto-hidden taskbar is on and, if you use multiple displays, which display the pointer is on when opening the popup. This distinguishes an edge-offset issue from monitor selection; the existing screenshot is sufficient.
